title: How Tall is Mount Everest? Official Height in Feet and Meters
snippet: 2 days ago · Mount Everest is 8,848.86 metres (29,031.7 feet) above sea level. That figure was set on 8 December 2020, when Nepal and China jointly announced the result of the first survey the two countries had ever conducted and agreed on together. It replaced the 8,848 m figure that had stood since 1955, and it is the height recognised by both governments today.
